title: mentha longifolia var. jurana
intro: Mentha longifolia var. jurana, commonly known as Hoary Mint, is a variant of the mint plant that is native to the Mediterranean region. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits including digestive relief, anti-inflammatory effects, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hoary Mint include its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety and stress, and alleviate respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Hoary Mint include menthone, menthyl acetate, and limonene, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and are responsible for its characteristic aroma and flavor.
